evals.prompt: Implement the next task from docs/specs/user-authentication/tasks.md following strict TDD and Stacked PR discipline.
evals.expected_output: Failing test written and verified, minimal implementation passing tests, code and security subagent audits approved, refactoring verified, atomic commit recorded, and draft PR stacked.
assertions: The agent discovers the feature specification and identifies the first uncompleted task (- [ ]) in tasks.md
The agent sets up or verifies the appropriate Stacked PR branch based on the specification branch for PR 1
The agent writes failing tests (Red) verifying Design by Contract (DbC) rules and boundary conditions before implementation
The agent leverages testing fixtures and formats data collections with formatter protection where applicable
The agent writes minimal production code using modern non-deprecated APIs to pass all tests (Green)
The agent eliminates trivial comment narration, writes standard Doc comments, and avoids specification ID dependencies in code
The agent concurrently invokes code-reviewer and security-reviewer subagents and resolves any identified issues
The agent executes a refactoring pass to streamline code and re-verifies that all tests pass without regressions
The agent updates tasks.md to mark the task completed (- [x]) and creates an atomic Conventional Commit via committing-changes
The agent submits a Stacked Draft PR via drafting-pull-request upon reaching a PR task boundary

evals.prompt: During implementation of task 2, a logical contradiction in the authentication token expiration contract is discovered.
evals.expected_output: Implementation is safely halted, user is notified, in-flight work is stashed, specification branch is checked out to revise specs via planning-and-designing, updates are sequentially merged, and work resumes.
assertions: The agent halts implementation upon discovering a specification defect rather than making speculative assumptions
The agent notifies the user and proposes an upstream specification revision
The agent safely stashes uncommitted implementation changes via git stash
The agent checks out the upstream specification branch and executes specification revision
The agent sequentially merges the updated specification into the stacked implementation branches via git merge
The agent restores stashed implementation work via git stash pop and resumes the TDD cycle
